# Loans and repayments
## Early repayment
A personal loan can be repaid early at any time. An early repayment charge of one percent of the outstanding balance applies in the first two years.
## Changing the repayment date
The monthly repayment date (EMI date) can be changed once a year on request.
## Loan statement
A loan statement showing the outstanding balance and interest paid is emailed on request.
